name: @kanzen/markdown-review-growth-client
description: Server-only, write-before-success client for the markdown-review growth service.

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && dts-bundle-generator --project tsconfig.json --no-banner --no-check -o dist/index.d.ts index.ts && bun build index.ts --outdir dist --packages external && tsc -p tsconfig.consumer-check.json
scripts.test: echo 'no standalone tests: client.test.ts needs ../src, so it only runs from the service repo checkout (bun run test:nested)'
